── Generic-LXC fallback ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
No nic/disk_bus/machine/qemu_arch - LXC has none of those concepts. max_cpu is
deliberately left unset so _build_hardware_defaults' os.cpu_count() ceiling applies -
lxc.py's limits.cpu genuinely honours a per-container core count, unlike namespace.
